rules: The one retained Gutenberg member must match the manifest bytes, line count, BOM, CRLF framing, and SHA-256.
Every retained physical line must be represented exactly once in source order and bound to its source byte interval.
Header, Gutenberg markers, work content, and license/support lines must retain their source-native classifications.
Part and section headings must remain typed source-line carriers without silent editorial normalization.
The candidate must be TEI P5 schema-valid, nonaccepted, and bound to this manifest and profile.
The independent oracle must reject source drift, accountability mutation, TEI line mutation, metadata mutation, and unresolved-boundary mutation.
Technical validation does not establish human acceptance, rights clearance, accepted IR, CVW review, or publication authorization.
